name: herd
description: Herd is a blazing fast, native Laravel and PHP development environment for macOS. It provides everything that you need to get started with Laravel development

subcommands.name: completion
subcommands.description: Dump the shell completion script

args.name: shell
args.description: The shell type (e.g. "bash"), the value of the "$SHELL" env var will be used if this is not given

subcommands.name: composer
subcommands.description: Proxy Composer commands with isolated site's PHP executable

subcommands.name: coverage
subcommands.description: Proxy PHP commands with isolated sith Xdebug code coverage enabled

subcommands.name: debug
subcommands.description: Proxy PHP commands with isolated site's PHP executable and debug.ini loaded

subcommands.name: directory-listing
subcommands.description: Determine directory-listing behavior. Default is off, which means a 404 will display

args.name: status
args.description: On or off. (default=off) will show a 404 page; [on] will display a listing if project folder exists but requested URI not found

subcommands.name: edit
subcommands.description: Open the site in your favorite IDE

subcommands.name: fetch-share-url
subcommands.description: Get the URL to the current share tunnel for Expose

subcommands.name: forget
subcommands.description: Remove the current working (or specified) directory from Herd's list of paths

subcommands.name: help
subcommands.description: Display help for a command

subcommands.name: init
subcommands.description: Start the services defined in the Herd manifest file, and apply the configuration

subcommands.name: isolate
subcommands.description: Change the version of PHP used by Herd to serve the current working directory

args.name: phpVersion
args.description: The PHP version you want to use; e.g 8.1

subcommands.name: isolate-node
subcommands.description: Change the version of Node used by the CLI for the current working directory

args.name: nodeVersion
args.description: The Node version you want to use; e.g 21

subcommands.name: isolated
subcommands.description: List all sites using isolated versions of PHP

subcommands.name: isolated-node
subcommands.description: List all sites using isolated versions of Nodes

subcommands.name: link
subcommands.description: Link the current working directory to Herd

subcommands.name: links
subcommands.description: Display all of the registered Herd links

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: List commands

subcommands.name: log
subcommands.description: Tail log file

subcommands.name: logs
subcommands.description: Show the log viewer UI for the given site

subcommands.name: loopback
subcommands.description: Get or set the loopback address used for Herd sites

subcommands.name: open
subcommands.description: Open the site for the current (or specified) directory in your browser

subcommands.name: park
subcommands.description: Register the current working (or specified) directory with Herd

subcommands.name: parked
subcommands.description: Display all the current sites within parked paths

subcommands.name: paths
subcommands.description: Get all of the paths registered with Herd

subcommands.name: php
subcommands.description: Proxy PHP commands with isolated site's PHP executable

subcommands.name: proxies
subcommands.description: Display all of the proxy sites

subcommands.name: proxy
subcommands.description: Create an Nginx proxy site for the specified host. Useful for Reverb, Docker, etc

subcommands.name: restart
subcommands.description: Restart the Herd services

subcommands.name: secure
subcommands.description: Secure the given domain with a trusted TLS certificate

subcommands.name: secured
subcommands.description: Secure the given domain with a trusted TLS certificate

subcommands.name: share
subcommands.description: Share the current site via an Expose tunnel

subcommands.name: site-information
subcommands.description: Display information about the specified site

subcommands.name: start
subcommands.description: Start the Herd services

subcommands.name: stop
subcommands.description: Stop the Herd services

subcommands.name: tinker
subcommands.description: Run tinker/Tinkerwell

subcommands.name: tld
subcommands.description: [domain] Get or set the TLD used for Herd sites

subcommands.name: unisolate
subcommands.description: Stop customizing the version of PHP used by Herd to serve the current working directory

subcommands.name: unisolate-node
subcommands.description: Stop customizing the version of Node used the CLI for the current working directory

subcommands.name: unlink
subcommands.description: Remove the specified Herd link

subcommands.name: unproxy
subcommands.description: Delete an Nginx proxy config

subcommands.name: unsecure
subcommands.description: Stop serving the given domain over HTTPS and remove the trusted TLS certificate

subcommands.name: use
subcommands.description: Change the version of PHP used by Herd

args.name: phpVersion
args.description: The PHP version you want to use; e.g. 8.3

subcommands.name: which
subcommands.description: Display which Herd driver serves the current working directory

subcommands.description: Get the PHP executable path for a given site

args.description: The site to get the PHP executable path for

subcommands.description: Initialize a Herd manifest file
